shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile, carved in low relief
animal forms rendered on the face of a large upright/blocky stone
multiple creatures combined on one surface
justification: Both surfaces present animal figures in shallow, outline-emphasised relief on the face of a large monolithic block, with a profile quadruped and a coiled/spiral element combined on the same surface, and in each case more than one creature appears stacked or juxtaposed rather than in a narrative scene. The clearest difference is that B's imagery is legible as a stalking quadruped above a second, more sinuous limbed creature arranged vertically down a flat panel, whereas A's carvings are dominated by a large volute/spiral and heavy head-like protrusions distributed across several irregular boulders, so the specific figures and their placement are not the same.
